name: ES Overnight Session Market Profile
description: Overnight session (6pm-9:30am ET) market profile and volume profile for ES futures on 5-minute bars. Computes POC, VAH, VAL, and value area width using a single-session rolling window (~186 bars). Tracks overnight profile levels for RTH preparation, with historical VA width distribution and event markers for unusually wide/narrow overnight sessions.
source:
# ES Overnight Session Market Profile
# Overnight = 18:00-09:30 ET on 5-minute bars
# Single-session volume profile: POC, VAH, VAL, VA width
# Tick size for ES = 0.25 points

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=5Min)()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
high = cont.h
low = cont.l
volume = cont.v
ts = index()

# --- Overnight Session Window (18:00-09:30 ET) ---
overnight = session_window(
    session=Session(start='18:00', end='09:30', tz='America/New_York')
)(cont.o, cont.h, cont.l, cont.c, cont.v)

# --- Volume Profile (single overnight session) ---
# ~186 five-minute bars in overnight session (15.5 hrs * 12 bars/hr)
vol_profile = price_profile(
    window_size=186,
    tick_size=0.25,
    value_area_pct=0.7,
    mode=ProfileType.volume
)(cont.h, cont.l, cont.c, cont.v)

# --- Market Profile / TPO (single overnight session) ---
mkt_profile = price_profile(
    window_size=186,
    tick_size=0.25,
    value_area_pct=0.7,
    mode=ProfileType.market
)(cont.h, cont.l, cont.c, cont.v)

# --- Capture overnight levels at session close ---
# Triple gate: session opened AND closed to avoid phantom events
on_close = overnight.closed and overnight.opened

# Volume profile levels at overnight close
on_poc = where(on_close, vol_profile.poc)
on_vah = where(on_close, vol_profile.vah)
on_val = where(on_close, vol_profile.val)
on_va_width = where(on_close, vol_profile.vah - vol_profile.val)

# TPO profile levels at overnight close
on_tpo_poc = where(on_close, mkt_profile.poc)

# Session stats at overnight close
on_high = where(on_close, overnight.high)
on_low = where(on_close, overnight.low)
on_range = where(on_close, overnight.high - overnight.low)
on_volume = where(on_close, overnight.volume)

# VA width as percentage of POC (for cross-period comparison)
on_va_width_pct = where(on_close and is_valid(vol_profile.poc) and vol_profile.poc > 0,
    (vol_profile.vah - vol_profile.val) / vol_profile.poc)

# --- Persist overnight levels for RTH reference ---
poc_level = ffill_day(on_poc)
vah_level = ffill_day(on_vah)
val_level = ffill_day(on_val)

# --- Historical VA width statistics ---
# Rolling 20-session average of overnight VA width
va_width_ma = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(ffill(on_va_width))

# Is tonight's VA unusually wide or narrow?
va_width_z = zscore(window=60)(ffill(on_va_width))
va_z_at_close = where(on_close, va_width_z)
is_wide = is_valid(va_z_at_close) and va_z_at_close > 1.5
is_narrow = is_valid(va_z_at_close) and va_z_at_close < -1.5
is_extreme = is_wide or is_narrow
regime_label = conditional_select(is_wide, "Wide", is_narrow, "Narrow", "Normal")

# --- Output 1: Overnight Profile Levels Over Time ---
xy_lines(
    title='Where Is Overnight Value Building?',
    category='Overnight Profile',
    y_axis_label='Price',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='POC', color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VAH', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VAL', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(poc_level, vah_level, val_level, close))

# --- Output 2: VA Width History ---
xy_lines(
    title='How Wide Is the Overnight Value Area?',
    category='Overnight Profile',
    y_axis_label='VA Width (pts)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    x_axis_label='',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VA Width', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20-Session Avg', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(ffill(on_va_width), va_width_ma))

# --- Output 3: Distribution of Overnight VA Widths ---
histogram(
    title='Typical Overnight Value Area Width',
    category='Overnight Profile',
    x_axis_label='VA Width (pts)',
    y_axis_label='Sessions',
    bins=25,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    show_analytics=True,
    order=3
)(on_va_width)

# --- Output 4: Summary Table ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Overnight Profile',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Overnight Session Profile Stats',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['POC', 'VAH', 'VAL', 'VA Width (pts)'],
        col_headers=['Latest', 'Avg (20-Session)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    order=0
)(on_poc, on_poc, on_vah, on_vah, on_val, on_val, on_va_width, on_va_width)

# --- Event Markers: Unusually Wide/Narrow Overnight Sessions ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Extreme Overnight VA Width',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Regime', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='VA Width', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='POC', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='ON High', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='ON Low', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(regime_label, on_va_width, on_poc, on_high, on_low, is_extreme)
